summary: Ran the two requested Node test files against the local sandbox Mongo. Both passed with no modifications. No reseller API endpoints were touched — only static source assertions + local throwaway-domain functional checks. Confirms (1) inner idempotency guard in cr-register-domain-&-create-cpanel.js now excludes own stub + failed ghosts while still catching true duplicates, (2) reseller-api outer dup check unchanged and still ignores failed, (3) anti-red challengePage() dead-end removed and all visitors get the proof-of-interaction button (high-score sc>=35 just delayed 1200ms).

test_results.test_reseller_dup_guard_2026-10.js: 10 passed, 0 failed (G1,G2,G3,A1,A2,A3 static + F1,F2,F3,F4 functional on local sandbox Mongo)
test_results.test_hosting_domain_registered_gate.js: 12 passed, 0 failed (regression — no breakage from cr-register change)

seed_data_creation: Functional test seeds a throwaway domain 'dupguardtest-<ts>.example' in local sandbox Mongo (DB_NAME=test) and self-cleans at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reseller API is LIVE production — never curl mutating endpoints. Verification path is `node /app/js/tests/test_reseller_dup_guard_2026-10.js` which exercises both static source assertions and local-Mongo functional guard behavior.
rca of the issue: Prior inner guard in cr-register-domain-&-create-cpanel.js matched the order's own placeholder stub and any prior failed/refunded ghost, raising spurious 'duplicate protection' errors and auto-refunding real paying users. Fix narrows the query to findOne({domain, deleted:{$ne:true}, provisionState:{$ne:'failed'}, _id:{$ne: info.customUsername||'__no_self__'}}). Anti-red challenge previously hard-failed (sc>=35 → up(100,'Verification failed') + early return) dead-ending humans; fix removes the kill branch and routes every visitor to the 'Continue to site' button, applying only a 1200ms delay for high-risk scores.
